# MFR Mobile Field Report MCP connector

Manage field service operations with Mobile Field Report (MFR). The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 71 MCP tools for MFR Mobile Field Report: 29 read and 42 can change data.

[![Open MFR Mobile Field Report in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Dmfr-fieldservice&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=mfr-fieldservice)

**Category:** [Field Service](../field-service.md) · **Tools:** 71 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp) · [Deutsch](https://anythingmcp.com/de/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp) · [Italiano](https://anythingmcp.com/it/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp) · [Español](https://anythingmcp.com/es/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp) · [日本語](https://anythingmcp.com/ja/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp) · [Русский](https://anythingmcp.com/ru/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp) · [中文](https://anythingmcp.com/zh/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the MFR Mobile Field Report connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The MFR Mobile Field Report connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your MFR Mobile Field Report account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/mfr-fieldservice-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-mfr-fieldservice-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Find service request with external ID SR-2026-118 for customer KraftHaus GmbH and current status*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["MFR Mobile Field Report API<br/>portal.mobilefieldreport.com"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, user name and password" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the MFR Mobile Field Report credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (user name and password), calls MFR Mobile Field Report, logs the call and returns the result.
- **MFR Mobile Field Report** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/de/mfr-fieldservice.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/de/mfr-fieldservice.json).

### `mfr_list_service_requests`

List service requests (work orders). Returns Id, Name, ExternalId, State, Type, Description, CustomerId, TargetTimeInMinutes, DueDateRangeStart/End, ClosedAt, ReleasedAt, WorkDoneAt, DateOfCreation, DateModified, CurrentOwnerId, CostCenterId, PortalLink, and IsTemplate. Supports OData $filter, $expand, $orderby, $top, $skip, and $select.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /ServiceRequests`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$top` | number | no | Max number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100) |
| `$skip` | number | no | Number of results to skip for pagination (e.g. 20 for page 2 with $top=20) |
| `$filter` | string | no | OData filter expression. Filterable fields: State (values: 'ReadyForScheduling', 'Scheduled', 'InProgress', 'Released', 'Closed'), Type ('IsServiceRequest'), ExternalId, Name, IsTemplate (true/false), DateModified, DateOfCreation, CustomerId, CurrentOwnerId, CostCenterId. Date format: datetime'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss'. Examples: "State eq 'InProgress'", "DateModified gt datetime'2025-01-01T00:00:00'", "State eq 'Closed' and DateModified gt datetime'2025-07-12T13:15:58Z'", "IsTemplate eq true", "ExternalId eq 'T-5432'". Operators: eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or, not. |
| `$orderby` | string | no | Sort results. Examples: 'DateModified desc', 'DateOfCreation asc', 'Name asc' |
| `$expand` | string | no | Expand related entities (comma-separated). Options: ServiceObjects, Customer, Reports, Items, Steps, Comments, Appointments, Appointments/Contacts, Tags, Qualifications |
| `$select` | string | no | Select specific fields to return (comma-separated). Example: 'Id,Name,State,DateModified' |

### `mfr_get_service_request`

Get a single service request by its numeric ID. Returns all fields including Id, Name, ExternalId, State, Type, Description, CustomerId, TargetTimeInMinutes, DueDateRangeStart/End, ClosedAt, ReleasedAt, WorkDoneAt, DateOfCreation, DateModified, CurrentOwnerId, CostCenterId, PortalLink, Location, CustomValues, Version, and IsTemplate.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /ServiceRequests({requestId}L)`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | string | yes | The service request numeric ID (e.g. '11164418048'). Use the 'L' suffix in the URL path. |
| `$expand` | string | no | Expand related entities. Options: ServiceObjects, Customer, Reports, Items, Steps, Comments, Appointments, Appointments/Contacts, Tags, Qualifications |

### `mfr_get_service_request_by_external_id`

Find a service request by its external ID (your system's reference). Returns matching service requests.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /ServiceRequests`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `externalId` | string | yes | The external ID to search for (e.g. 'T-5432') |
| `$expand` | string | no | Expand related entities. Options: ServiceObjects, Customer, Reports, Items, Steps, Comments, Appointments, Appointments/Contacts, Tags, Qualifications |

### `mfr_create_service_request`

Create a new service request (work order). Returns the created service request with its Id.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /ServiceRequests`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Name` | string | yes | Title/name of the service request |
| `Description` | string | no | Detailed description (HTML supported) |
| `ExternalId` | string | no | Your system's reference ID |
| `TargetTimeInMinutes` | number | no | Estimated time to complete in minutes |
| `CustomerId` | string | no | Company/customer ID to link |
| `CurrentOwnerId` | string | no | Contact ID of the responsible technician |
| `DueDateRangeEnd` | string | no | Due date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. '2026-06-15T00:00:00Z') |
| `DueDateRangeStart` | string | no | Start of due date range in ISO 8601 format |
| `CostCenterId` | string | no | Cost center ID (use '0' for none) |
| `IsTemplate` | boolean | no | Set to true to create a template instead of a regular request |
| `Type` | string | no | Request type. Values: 'IsServiceRequest' (default), 'IsStandardTemplate' (for templates) |
| `CreateFromServiceRequestTemplateId` | string | no | Create from an existing template by providing the template's ID |

### `mfr_update_service_request`

Update an existing service request. Only include fields you want to change.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /ServiceRequests({requestId}L)`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | string | yes | The service request numeric ID |
| `Name` | string | no | Updated title/name |
| `Description` | string | no | Updated description (HTML supported) |
| `ExternalId` | string | no | Updated external reference ID |
| `TargetTimeInMinutes` | string | no | Updated estimated time in minutes |
| `CustomerId` | string | no | Updated company/customer ID |
| `CurrentOwnerId` | string | no | Updated responsible technician contact ID |
| `DueDateRangeEnd` | string | no | Updated due date (ISO 8601) |
| `CostCenterId` | string | no | Updated cost center ID |

### `mfr_delete_service_request`

Delete a service request by its numeric ID. This action is irreversible.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | string | yes | The service request numeric ID to delete |

### `mfr_list_appointments`

List scheduled appointments for field technicians. Returns Id, State, Type/AppointmentType, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, ContactId, ContactIds, ServiceRequestId, Note, ExternalId, DrivingDistanceFrom/To, CreatedAt, and Version.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /Appointments`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$top` | number | no | Max number of results to return |
| `$skip` | number | no | Number of results to skip for pagination |
| `$filter` | string | no | OData filter. Filterable fields: State ('NotVisited', 'InProgress', 'IsWorkDone', 'Rejected'), Type/AppointmentType ('Standard', 'Vacation', 'Illness', 'Other', 'Task'), StartDateTime, EndDateTime, ContactId, ServiceRequestId. Examples: "State eq 'InProgress'", "StartDateTime ge datetime'2026-03-01T00:00:00' and StartDateTime le datetime'2026-03-31T23:59:59'", "ContactId eq '410583043'", "Type eq 'Vacation'" |
| `$orderby` | string | no | Sort results. Examples: 'StartDateTime asc', 'EndDateTime desc', 'CreatedAt desc' |
| `$expand` | string | no | Expand related entities. Options: Contacts |
| `$select` | string | no | Select specific fields (comma-separated) |

### `mfr_create_appointment`

Create a new appointment (standard, vacation, illness, or other).

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /Appointments`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Type` | string | yes | Appointment type. Values: 'Standard' (field work), 'Vacation', 'Illness', 'Other', 'Task' |
| `StartDateTime` | string | yes | Start date/time in ISO 8601 (e.g. '2026-06-15T08:00:00Z') |
| `EndDateTime` | string | yes | End date/time in ISO 8601 (e.g. '2026-06-15T16:00:00Z') |
| `ContactId` | string | yes | Primary technician/contact ID |
| `ContactIds` | any[] | no | Array of contact IDs for multiple assigned technicians (e.g. ['410583043', '1767604224']) |
| `ServiceRequestId` | string | no | Service request ID to link (use '0' for standalone appointments like vacation) |
| `State` | string | no | Initial state. Values: 'NotVisited' (default), 'InProgress', 'IsWorkDone', 'Rejected' |
| `Note` | string | no | Additional notes for the appointment |

### `mfr_update_appointment`

Update an existing appointment.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /Appointments({appointmentId}L)`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appointmentId` | string | yes | The appointment numeric ID |
| `Type` | string | no | Updated type: 'Standard', 'Vacation', 'Illness', 'Other', 'Task' |
| `State` | string | no | Updated state: 'NotVisited', 'InProgress', 'IsWorkDone', 'Rejected' |
| `StartDateTime` | string | no | Updated start (ISO 8601) |
| `EndDateTime` | string | no | Updated end (ISO 8601) |
| `ContactId` | string | no | Updated technician/contact ID |
| `Note` | string | no | Updated notes |

### `mfr_delete_appointment`

Delete an appointment by its numeric ID.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `DELETE /Appointments({appointmentId}L)`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `appointmentId` | string | yes | The appointment numeric ID to delete |

### `mfr_create_step`

Create a new checklist step in a service request or step list template.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /Steps`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `StepListTemplateId` | string | no | Template ID (for template steps) |
| `ParentId` | string | no | Parent step ID for nested steps within a Group (use '0' for root level) |
| `Data` | string | no | JSON string defining step fields. For EnterValue: {"fields": [{"isRequired": true, "name": "Field name", "type": "text\|choice\|float", "enumeration": "Opt1;Opt2", "unit": "kg"}]} |

| `Description` | string | no | Updated description |
| `Data` | string | no | Updated JSON field data |
| `ServiceRequestId` | string | no | Service request ID |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **MFR Mobile Field Report** and enter `MFR_USERNAME`, `MFR_PASSWORD`, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
